My dear [Mrs Barrett Lennard](/person/121)
I am afraid I do not know any one at Cambridge well enough to write about one whom I do not personally know. I do not think second hand recommendations have much effect people have so many first hand.

In fact I only slightly know two people there. I was there some twelve or fourteen years ago and like you, was edified by the admiration of ‘Our Backs’- I never could care for Cambridge as for Oxford.
I am sure I sent you our [Magazine](/periodical/85) for November.[^1] There was an account of the Colonial Exhibition in it, written by [Miss Finlaison](/person/512) I hope it did not fail of coming.

yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Perhaps the Otterbourne Parish Magazine.

The India and Colonial Exhibition took place in South Kensington in 1886.
